note: After the fuzzer flag bytes, the input-controlled JSON text is handed to the FlatBuffers parser.
The parser stores the input buffer pointer as the lexer source that Next will scan.
The leading input-controlled plus sign selects the signed numeric-token path.
The +/-inf recognizer should check the byte immediately after the three letters inf; using cursor_[4] skips one byte past that boundary and can inspect a byte beyond the string terminator.
For the +inf input, this conditional reads cursor_[4] past the initialized input string terminator, which is the MemorySanitizer use-of-uninitialized-value target.
